in_sanskrit.name: Merugu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Mercy
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Merugu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Merugu is derived from the Tamil word 'Meru', which means mountain, and the prefix 'Gu' meaning god. This name is believed to represent the God of Mercy. The name is also associated with the concept of protection and is often used as a term of endearment.
